native_controls.parent_ownership: target session existence, ended-state and compression-lineage checks
native_controls.profile_boundary: profile-scoped state.db/runtime scope; no native AOTA cross-profile proof
native_controls.session_injection: internal MessageEvent is created only by gateway-owned path; API continuation requires API_SERVER_KEY
native_controls.duplicate_delivery: claim token, delivery identity, bounded retries; not exactly-once
native_controls.failure_timeout_cancelled: native and AOTA terminal statuses are structured; adapter must allowlist
native_controls.raw_output: native formatter/AOTA outbox are structured; current AOTA outbox excludes raw logs and secrets

required_adapter_controls: parent profile validation and explicit routing
task origin and trusted finalizer validation
stable idempotency key and duplicate suppression
canonical result pointer under approved runtime root
stale event, deleted session and closed session fail-closed handling
audit receipt and terminal drop disposition
current_aota_gap: outbox has origin_session_id and event_id, but no explicit parent_profile, parent_session_id, result_pointer, or Hermes authenticated backend trust contract
